north_star: Frontier-level problem solving with minimum necessary computation
hypothesis: Can an own-weight neural proposer learn to generate source-dependent, typed two-array quantified relation atoms not in previous G3 H0 and independently prove untouched original CHC copy loops; how much does it add over strong classical same-rights synthesis?
explicit_limits: H1 two-array COPY_PREFIX was human-proposed and independently proved only as abstract loop. Do not call it model invention.
This copy4/5/6 family is same-DSL transfer, NOT Q6 cross-formalism.
No external original source bodies may be read before model, grammar, evaluator, same-rights classical baselines and cost budgets are frozen.
No model has yet been trained for H1 and no target has been evaluated.
Target original expected verdict is not a model training label.
materialization: These filenames/blobs were selected solely from public Git-tree metadata, not by source-body inspection in this experiment.
test_author_independence: All sources share CHC-COMP published quic3/data and related standard_copy family. Not independent author/formalism transfer.
before_future_first_required: trainable own-weight proposer with exact weight SHA, random seed, target-blind source roles and grammar
no data leakage through original names or stage counts
strong Z3/Eldarica native at published source rights and bounded resource budgets
equal-language classical counterexample guided synthesis baseline and human H1 direct rule
independent original unchanged Horn clause refutation verifier and mutated candidate controls
same iso-capability total resource accounting and degraded ABSTAIN mode
first receipt and full original source artifacts immutable
current_H0_why_insufficient: Single-array, constant-value interval predicates cannot generally express cross-array copy relation; real copy2/3 originals require multiple array operands.
proposed_H1_source: human-proposed and source-free mathematically proven COPY_PREFIX, not a demonstrated autonomous invention
